structure_1YYP_audit.title: Crystal structure of cytomegalovirus UL44 bound to C-terminal peptide from CMV UL54
structure_1YYP_audit.entity_1: UL44 processivity factor (residues 1-290, core sliding clamp)

conclusion: No experimental crystal or cryo-EM structure of the catalytic core of HCMV UL54 exists in the RCSB PDB as of November 2026. Entry 1YYP covers only the 22-residue C-terminal sliding-clamp binding peptide. Computing 3D Euclidean active-site distance on UL54 requires predicted coordinates (AlphaFold DB AF-P08546-F1) or structural alignment to HSV-1 UL30 experimental holoenzyme (PDB 8V1Q / 8EXX).
